newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy sends urgent humanitarian aid to Gaza.
newsitem.headline: Italy sends urgent humanitarian aid to Gaza.

text.p: Italy has sent a planeload of emergency humanitarian aid to Gaza after an urgent telephone request from Palestinian President Yasser Arafat, the Italian foreign ministry said on Sunday.

The ministry said in a statement that a special G222 military aircraft left Pisa for Gaza during the night. It said the flight, carrying sanitary and surgical equipment, was organised with the agreement of Israeli authorities.
Arafat requested the aid during a phone conversation with Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini on Saturday, the statement said.
It followed the dispatch of medicines and equipment worth $100,000 already supplied by Italy in the wake of clashes sparked by the opening of an archeological tunnel in Jerusalem.
Fifty-five Palestinians and 14 Israelis have died in five days of clashes, mostly gunbattles, in the West Bank, Gaza Strip and Jerusalem since a new entrance was punched in the tunnel.

It shows ancient ruins revered by Jews but runs near Islamic sites. The tunnel opening prompted international condemnation and triggered protests by Palestinians, who called it an assault on Islamic shrines.
